description: Phase 1: stand up the SeeFlow-hosted relay (API Gateway WebSocket + Lambdas + DynamoDB) with session create, host/peer auth handshake, and a smoke-test CLI. Full plan at /Users/tuongaz/dev/seeflow/docs/plans/2026-05-31-live-share-phase-1-relay.md. ALL CODE CHANGES HAPPEN IN /Users/tuongaz/dev/seeflow-viewer/cloud/ — read the plan for exact file paths, complete code, and test bodies before each story.

userStories.title: Add Live Share deps and test script to seeflow-viewer/cloud
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need cloud/package.json to declare the AWS SDK + Zod deps and a bun test script so subsequent stories can install and run tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `test`: `bun test` to scripts in cloud/package.json

userStories.title: Add ShareSessions DDB table and WebSocket API skeleton to CDK stack
userStories.description: As the relay infra, I need a DynamoDB table with a token GSI and TTL, plus a WebSocket API with three placeholder routes, so later stories can attach real lambda handlers.
acceptanceCriteria: Follow plan Task 1 — code and CDK assertion test bodies in /Users/tuongaz/dev/seeflow/docs/plans/2026-05-31-live-share-phase-1-relay.md
Create cloud/lib/seeflow-stack.share.test.ts with the three CDK assertion tests (DDB table, token GSI, WebSocket API with $connect/$disconnect/$default)
Modify cloud/lib/seeflow-stack.ts to add the DDB table, GSI, WebSocket API, stage, CfnOutput, and placeholder lambda + routes

userStories.title: Implement share id generators (sessionId, token, peerId)
userStories.description: As later handlers, I need short url-safe random ids for sessions, tokens, and peer ids so connection records can be created.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/ids.ts with urlSafe, newSessionId (8 chars), newToken (43 chars), newPeerId
Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/ids.test.ts covering length, charset, padding stripping

userStories.title: Implement HMAC peer JWT mint and verify
userStories.description: As the peer-join lambda, I need to mint short-lived signed peer tokens (HMAC-SHA256) and the ws-default lambda needs to verify them, with no external dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/jwt.ts exporting mintPeerToken and verifyPeerToken using node:crypto only
Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/jwt.test.ts covering round-trip, tampered, expired, wrong-secret cases

userStories.title: Implement envelope Zod schema and parser
userStories.description: As every lambda, I need a single source of truth for the WebSocket message envelope so frames can be validated uniformly.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/envelope.ts with EnvelopeSchema (z.literal(1) version, full type enum) and parseEnvelope helper
Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/envelope.test.ts covering valid rpc, wrong version, unknown type, auth-host, auth-peer

userStories.title: Implement DDB session helpers (create, get, peer ops, touch)
userStories.description: As all lambdas, I need typed wrappers around DocumentClient for ShareSessions so handlers don't write raw DDB commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/ddb.ts exporting doc (DocumentClient) and TABLE
Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/sessions.ts exporting SessionRow, PeerInfo, createSession, getBySessionId, getByToken, setHostConnId, addPeer, removePeer, touch (all with 30-min TTL refresh)
Create cloud/lambda/share/shared/sessions.test.ts with in-memory fake of doc.send covering Put/Get/Query/Update commands

userStories.title: Implement POST /api/share/sessions handler (session-create)
userStories.description: As the host studio, I want a POST endpoint that creates a new session row and returns sessionId, token, hostKey, wsUrl.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/session-create.test.ts covering happy path (200 with all four fields) and 500 when SHARE_WS_URL is missing
Handler reads SHARE_WS_URL from env, generates ids via shared/ids, calls createSession, returns JSON with CORS headers

userStories.title: Implement POST /api/share/join handler (session-join)
userStories.description: As a peer browser, I want a POST endpoint that validates the share token, mints a 5-minute peer JWT, and returns sessionId, wsUrl, peerJwt, hostOnline, flowList.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/session-join.test.ts covering happy path (200 with peerJwt + hostOnline:true), 404 for unknown token, 400 for missing displayName
Handler reads SHARE_WS_URL and SHARE_JWT_SECRET from env, validates body, calls getByToken, mints token via shared/jwt, returns JSON with CORS headers
DisplayName is trimmed and capped at 40 chars

userStories.title: Implement WebSocket $connect handler (ws-connect)
userStories.description: As the WebSocket API, I need a $connect handler that always returns 200 — real auth happens in the first frame on $default.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/ws-connect.ts exporting handler returning {statusCode:200, body:'ok'}

userStories.title: Implement WebSocket $disconnect handler (ws-disconnect)
userStories.description: As the WebSocket API, I need a $disconnect handler that finds the dropped connection in DDB and either clears hostConnId or removes the peer entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/ws-disconnect.ts exporting handler that scans ShareSessions, identifies role by connId, calls setHostConnId(null) or removePeer
Create cloud/lambda/share/ws-disconnect.test.ts covering host-disconnect, peer-disconnect, and unknown-conn (200 no-op) paths

userStories.title: Implement WebSocket $default handler (ws-default) with auth + routing
userStories.description: As the WebSocket API, I need a $default handler that processes auth-host/auth-peer frames, then routes subsequent frames by `to` (host, all, single connId) using PostToConnection, cleaning up gone connections.
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/lambda/share/ws-default.ts implementing parseEnvelope -> handleAuthHost / handleAuthPeer / routeFrame
handleAuthHost: 401 if hostKey mismatches; on success calls setHostConnId
handleAuthPeer: 401 if JWT invalid/expired; on success calls addPeer
routeFrame: 401 if connId not authed; fans out to host/all/specific connId; sender never receives its own frame; GoneException triggers setHostConnId(null) or removePeer
Logs only {type, from, to, sizeBytes} — NEVER payload
Create cloud/lambda/share/ws-default.test.ts covering auth-host wrong/right key, auth-peer expired/valid, route-from-unauthed, route-to-host, route-to-all fan-out, GoneException cleanup

userStories.title: Wire share lambdas + IAM grants + HTTP routes into CDK stack
userStories.description: As the deployed infra, I need all five share lambdas registered with proper environment variables, DDB read/write grants, ManageConnections grant on the WS API, three real WebSocket route integrations, and two HTTP routes on the existing httpApi.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend cloud/lib/seeflow-stack.share.test.ts with three new assertions: POST /api/share/sessions route, POST /api/share/join route, DDB grants on >=5 lambdas, ManageConnections grant present

Modify cloud/lib/seeflow-stack.ts: add ShareJwtSecret CfnParameter (noEcho), define sharedEnv {SHARE_TABLE, SHARE_WS_URL, SHARE_JWT_SECRET}, create the five NodejsFunctions (session-create, session-join, ws-connect, ws-disconnect, ws-default) with that env
Grant shareSessions.grantReadWriteData on all 5 lambdas; grant shareWsApi.grantManageConnections on ws-default
Replace the three placeholder route integrations with real WebSocketLambdaIntegration per route
Add HTTP routes POST /api/share/sessions and POST /api/share/join to the existing httpApi
`bun test lib/seeflow-stack.share.test.ts` passes (all assertions including new ones)

userStories.title: Add Live Share smoke-test CLI
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a Bun script that drives the relay end-to-end so a manual deploy can be verified with two terminals (host + peer).
acceptanceCriteria: Create cloud/bin/share-smoke.ts as a Bun script supporting `host` and `join <token>` modes
`host` mode: POST /api/share/sessions, open WS, send auth-host frame, send sse tick every 5s
`join <token>` mode: POST /api/share/join, open WS, send auth-peer frame, log incoming frames
Script parses with `bun --check bin/share-smoke.ts` (or equivalent syntax check) without error
